name: files
description: Find, look at and bring over files on this machine and the box, inside the folders the user chose and never anywhere secret.

tips.text: Run `vyre send report.pdf` on your Mac to Taildrop it to the box. It lands in the box's inbox, `/work/inbox`.
`files.deliver` Taildrops a file from the box to a paired Mac's `~/Vyre/inbox`, once that Mac turns files.receive on.
A Mac takes box deliveries only once you turn `files.receive` on. Off by default, so pairing never changes Taildrop. Applies at once.
Press Control twice and type a file's name. The Capsule searches your Mac with Spotlight, plus up to three files from your box.
Files never shows secrets: `.env` files, key-like names, dot folders and `~/.ssh` stay out of every search and send.
`vyre send` takes several files at once. One refused file does not stop the rest, and the exit code says if any failed.
Files looks only in the folders you chose: `/work` on a box and your home on a Mac, until `files.roots` in config.json says otherwise.
Want Taildrop files somewhere else on the box? Set `files.inbox` in config.json to a folder inside one of your roots.
Open Find in the Deck, `/find`, to search sessions, files, agents, memory and projects in one box. On the phone it is a tab.
Mount a shared box folder at `~/Vyre/Box/<share>` with `vyre call files.drive.mount` so Finder opens box files in place.
`vyre call files.recent` lists the folders your sessions worked in lately, newest first, with how many sessions ran in each.
Pick what to share from the folders on your server: `files.drive.candidates` lists them, projects first, and `files.drive.measure` says how big one is before you share it.
`files.drive.search` finds a file on your server by its name or what's in it, across every folder you've shared.
